H3 is not newly granted: most variational/selector and spectral technology is supplied, and the remaining local construction is bounded.

compared.statement: For arbitrary completed exact L with compact gamma-support, every base cohomology class injects into the neighborhood-cohomology direct limit of gamma-support.

compared.actual_SQL_statement_read: For uniformly convergent horizontal absolutely continuous curves gamma_n with finite liminf L-action under the stated uniform superlinearity/boundedness/strict convexity assumptions, the limit remains horizontal absolutely continuous and its action is at most the liminf.
compared.difference: Lower semicontinuity/compactness for subriemannian action; no completed Lagrangian, spectral support, exact conjugacy or Birkhoff inclusion.

compared.actual_native_statement_read: The fixed point u of the implicit contact-action operator A is a variational solution of the contact Hamilton–Jacobi initial-value problem: domination along every test curve and equality along a calibrated curve to each endpoint.
compared.difference: A variational characterization for a contact HJ evolution on R^n with its explicit Hamiltonian assumptions, not a derivative-graph inclusion in gamma-support of a spectral completed fixed point.
